name: Ancient Whetstone's weapon enchant deals its Fire damage on melee hits (#13200)
contract: #13200: Ancient Whetstone (410189) casts 201173 (cast directly here, as its use spell), which consumes a Heart of Fire (7077) and enchants a weapon with enchantment 1005. Its equip aura 201174 triggers 201175 (31-40 Fire) at the 10% chance Spell.dbc gives it, but the aura had no proc flags, so it never fired.

A warrior with a 0.5 s dagger and full hit and expertise swings at a dummy until 300 melee hits land. At 10% the chance of no proc is 0.9^300, about 2e-14; the upper bound of 80 rules out a proc on every hit with a residual chance below 1e-20.

steps.label: CONTROL: the whetstone enchants the dagger
CONTROL: the Heart of Fire is consumed
CONTROL: the enchantment (1005) is on the dagger and applies its equip aura
DISCRIMINATING: the enchant's Fire damage procs on some hits, not on every hit
